Works the river for you: 3g per cycle beside water.
Holds +150 gold above the pan cap.

objectiveMetadata.description: Keep the Mare Claim alive when an early lunar eclipse kills the solar economy in the middle of the run.
objectiveMetadata.teachingIntent: Reserves are love letters to your future self.

eclipseShadowZones.description: The eclipse shadow crosses the whole claim and ends solar production mid-run.

engineDependencies.description: The headless door composes the atmosphere wall and the eclipse event: mid-run the shadow takes the solar-fed dome pads offline, leaves the pad nearest the claim as the reserve, and the secure then needs a regolith ground worked on the hero air after it lands. Since 2026-09-07 the suit is hers and an empty one costs five hit points a second, so the reserve is a life-support ration rather than a bookkeeping note. The authored shadow-zone rectangle itself still has no consumer, and the BROWSER composes neither the atmosphere nor the eclipse, so this dependency stays missing.

boardRow.name: The Eclipse
boardRow.ledgerBlurb: The Mare Claim's dome pads, regolith fields, and mass-driver return beneath a dark sky.

goals: Build among the Mare Claim's dome cluster and rim pads.
Work the six regolith harvest grounds across the flat.
rules: Seven surveyed build grounds span the rim and mare flat.
The eastbound mass-driver rail crosses the southern footing.
Waves enter from the north, west, and east.
The claim is not made until four of the six regolith grounds are worked with air still in the suit.
Only one ground counts in each four-wave window, so the run is made in trips; a ground worked while her suit is empty counts for nothing.
Outside the domes there is no air. The hero lands six paces north of the dome cluster with sixty seconds in her suit, and the shadow leaves just one dome breathing.
An empty suit costs her five hit points every second until she reaches air.
briefing.geographyLine: The Mare Claim rim, dome cluster, regolith fields, launch pad, and mass-driver rail beneath a dark sky.
